style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with powder-blue infographic fields #DCEAF6 and pale terry-texture panels #F2F6FA
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #14406B inside circular badges, numbered circles for lists
style.lightingSystem: bright cool high-key studio light from the front-left with a soft fill card, gentle skimming light on texture close-ups, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean pharmacy-blue skincare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, powder-blue infographic field #DCEAF6, deep blue accent #14406B and pale stone surface #E7E2DC; cool high-key studio lighting from the front-left with a soft fill card and soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif family only; thin single-weight line icons in deep blue #14406B inside circular badges; rounded lozenge label pills and flat panel cards; stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and constant carton scale; every seal, chart and label left as a blank placeholder shape; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented figures.
noDrift: no filled-in seals, badges, charts or numerals
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and constant carton scale across the set; a single sheet always lifted from the dispensing slot with one soft drape; flat accent band #14406B at the carton base
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone shelf #E7E2DC and soft white terry-texture field #F2F6FA
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only, short labels kept inside rounded lozenge pills
